system.description:
You begin to collect lightning release chakra until it sparks off of your weapon and body with violent jolts. You make a singular forward slash as lightning forms an image of a beast of your description behind you.

Move yourself into a space adjacent to a creature of your choice within range that can hold you and make a melee taijutsu attack.

On a hit, you deal your [Weapons damage] + 4d10 lightning damage. If the target has any ranks of the Shocked condition, you make your attacks at advantage.

Chain 2: Your attack is so swift, that your attacks ignore bonuses to AC as a result of Jutsu.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d10.
